class: Detected unsupported claims survive correction failure and cached reuse
symptom: Fal's first Gemini draft triggered PA-5200 rejection. Investigation reproduced PDF generation when a corrective draft still overclaims or its request raises. The saved Fal PDF itself passes the existing claim checker.
root_cause: The retry selected fewer unsupported claims but lacked a final rejection gate before PDF generation; cached tailored PDFs were returned without revalidation.
why_tests_missed: Document reuse tests checked storage and call counts, not rejection after a failed or partially improved correction.
fix: Reject every draft with remaining detected unsupported claims, continue the configured provider fallback, and validate stored PDF text before reuse. Existing original-resume fallback remains available.
prevention: Validation must gate artifact creation and cache reuse. A smaller error count is not a successful correction; test error, partial correction, clean correction, and fallback.
